column1: # Partition layout for ESP32-S3 with 16MB flash.
# Retention: ~132 days per device (3 ThermoPro + 1 ping
# OTA slots: 3MB each — ample for S3 binary with aggregator code + PSRAM support.
# IMPORTANT: ota_0 must start at 0x10000 — this is where PlatformIO/esptool
# writes the app binary. Placing ota_0 at a different offset causes the bootloader
# to look for the app in the wrong location (BUG-061 / flash bricking issue).
